name: DownloadState
title: DownloadState
summary: Offline and download indicators for ISM apps: the 44px download button in its four states, a storage usage row, and offline / back-online banners.
whenToUse: Use the download button on any Bible, audio or language row that can be saved for offline use.
Use the storage row at the top of Manage downloads.
Show the offline banner under the AppBar while the phone has no connection; show Back online briefly when it returns.
Use the inline warning when the reader opens something that is not downloaded while offline.

props.name: status
props.description:
`idle` hairline circle with ↓, `downloading` progress ring with a stop square, `paused` ring with a
resume triangle, `downloaded` success tick, `error` retry on error tint. State is never colour alone:
the icon shape changes too, and the row subtitle should change.

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress from 0 to 1 for `downloading` and `paused`. Update at most every 250 ms.

props.name: itemName
props.description: Name of the item, used in the accessible name ("Download Amharic").

props.name: small
props.description: 36px button with a 44px hit area, for dense lists.

props.name: status
props.description: Current state. State is shown by icon shape too, never colour alone.

props.name: itemName
props.description: Name of the item for the accessible name: "Amharic".

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called on press: start (idle), stop (downloading), manage or open (downloaded), retry (error).

props.name: small
props.description: 36dp visual with a 44dp hit area, for dense lists.

variants.meaning: 3px Horizon Blue ring on --gray-200, stop square

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The button is always 44×44 and on the right of the row.
Ring dasharray = progress × 119.4 (the circumference); update it at most every 250ms.
Show size before download ("312 MB") and progress during ("193 of 312 MB").
Storage bar: Bibles Horizon Blue, audio `--gradient-violet`, other `--gray-300`; always show the legend with numbers.
While offline, keep downloaded rows normal and mark the rest disabled with "Needs a connection".
Never block the screen for offline; the banner is enough.
do: Use the download button on any Bible, audio or language row that can be saved for offline use.
Use the storage row at the top of Manage downloads.
Show the offline banner under the AppBar while the phone has no connection; show Back online briefly when it returns.
Use the inline warning when the reader opens something that is not downloaded while offline.
The button is always 44×44 and on the right of the row.
Ring dasharray = progress × 119.4 (the circumference); update it at most every 250ms.
Show size before download ("312 MB") and progress during ("193 of 312 MB").
Storage bar: Bibles Horizon Blue, audio `--gradient-violet`, other `--gray-300`; always show the legend with numbers.
While offline, keep downloaded rows normal and mark the rest disabled with "Needs a connection".
dont: Never block the screen for offline; the banner is enough.
accessibility: Each button's name says the action and item: "Download Amharic", "Stop download, 62 percent", "Retry download".
Banners use `role="status"` so the change is announced once.
The storage bar has `role="img"` and an `aria-label` with all values.
State never relies on colour alone: icon shape and subtitle change too.
content: "This Bible isn’t downloaded" / "Download Español · NBLA to read it without a connection."
Mark example sizes as samples in specs.

html:
Amharic አማርኛ312 MB · Bible + audio
…You’re offline · Downloaded Bibles still work

<button class="ap-dl" type="button" aria-label="Stop download, 62 percent">
  <svg width="44" height="44" viewBox="0 0 44 44"><circle class="ap-ring-track" cx="22" cy="22" r="19"/>
  <circle class="ap-ring-val" cx="22" cy="22" r="19" stroke-dasharray="74 120" transform="rotate(-90 22 22)"/>
  <rect class="ap-ring-stop" x="17" y="17" width="10" height="10" rx="2"/></svg>
</button>
